verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a fintech platform with public APIs, so an official MCP server is a fair thing for buyers to ask about, and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The llms.txt file, SDKs, webhooks and in-product AI features (Spend AI, Kai) are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
